test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight students A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table in the same order in anticlockwise direction, at equal distances from each other. If B is seated in the north-east direction, in which direction is H seated?
solution:
We know that:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d72d0dd98232686e796e7ff34049c1ebcfea0d29d274a25317671f6c1395e86b.png] 

Given:

1) Eight students A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table** in the same order in __anticlockwise direction__.**

2) Equal distances from each other.

3) B is seated in the **north-east** direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af66cbf963319dbce04b7aeff627d832b311da039d64a01d59c9ec90ffffc38e.png] 

**Now, eight students A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in the same order in anticlockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cbc4bafcd4769c393738506f461d4b670212cc7851cdc9475c8ea4ad4111669.png] 

Hence, H is seated in the **“South-East” **direction.
